Bulk actions are built and verified. Try them in the demo view (it has plenty of items): **http://maker:4001/?demo=edge**

1. **Enter selection mode.** Click **Select** (top right). Checkboxes appear on each card and a blue action bar shows at the top.
2. **Pick some links**, or use **Select all** to select everything in the current view/filter (not just the loaded page — the whole filtered set).
3. **Apply an action to all of them:** **Read later**, **Mark as read**, **Archive**, **Add tag** (type a tag then press Add), or **Delete**. Watch the counts update; the selection clears after each action.
4. **In the Archived view**, the bar switches to offer **Restore** (and Delete) for the selected archived links.
5. **Bulk delete is confirmed** — it tells you how many will be permanently removed and suggests archiving instead.
6. **Click Done** to leave selection mode.

Choices I made — please check:

- **Selection is a distinct "Select" mode** (checkboxes only appear then), keeping normal browsing uncluttered. Good, or would you want checkboxes always visible?
- **Bulk actions offered:** set reading state, archive/restore, add a tag, delete. **Add tag only adds** (it never removes existing tags). Is add-only enough, or do you also need a bulk **remove-a-tag**?
- **Select all covers the entire filtered set**, so you can act on hundreds at once even though only some are loaded on screen. Right?

Once bulk actions feel right, next is **saving useful search-and-tag combinations (saved views).**
